'''Ryvus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] began training Tarisian settlers to form a militia and defend themselves against the Empire. Hoping to defeat them, he tasked an Imperial spacer to destroy the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the Tarisian Militia Forces.
